title: CollaborationCandidate
description: Storage shape of one review candidate. It repeats the artifact fields explicitly and adds the proposal, the work generation and the two independent authorization references. rerun_authorization_ref records how the generation was authorized; commit_authorization_ref records how the commit was authorized. Under manual approval commit_authorization_ref is null. Only status, decided_at and decision_ref change after creation.

body.description: Raw model output text. content_digest is sha256 over its UTF-8 bytes.

proposal.description: Parsed and domain-normalised commit basis. Its canonical form is exactly the request_payload C05d passes to commit_command, without request_id or digest.

command_digest.description: Must equal Tx B _request_digest(namespace, operation, context_id, request_payload). Bare 64-character lower-case hex.

structural_validation.description: Only a structurally valid proposal becomes a candidate; a failed parse is an interaction failure, not a candidate.

rerun_authorization_ref.description: grant_id of the rerun grant that authorised this generation; null at generation 0 when the work was never rejected.

commit_authorization_ref.description: grant_id of the commit grant that authorised this commit; null when the commit path is manual approval.

decision_ref.description: Audit reference of the approval/rejection decision; null while pending.
